dz: 效忠于罗马元老院的军团由盖乌斯·潘萨(Gaius Pansa)指挥,在"论坛"加洛鲁姆之战中击败了马克·安东尼的军队.
de: Legions loyal to the Roman Senate, commanded by Gaius Pansa, defeat the forces of Mark Antony in the Battle of Forum Gallorum.

te: Mark Antony is again defeated in battle by Aulus Hirtius, who is killed. Antony fails to capture Mutina and Decimus Bru…
dz: 穆蒂纳战役:马克·安东尼在战斗中被被被杀死的奥卢斯·赫尔提乌斯再次击败. 安东尼没能抓住穆蒂娜,德西穆斯·布鲁特斯不久后被谋杀.
de: Battle of Mutina: Mark Antony is again defeated in battle by Aulus Hirtius, who is killed. Antony fails to capture Mutina and Decimus Brutus is murdered shortly after.

dz: 尤利乌斯·凯撒被谋杀后，他的侄子兼继承人屋大维利用武力威胁迫使罗马元老院选举他为执政官。
de: In the wake of the murder of Julius Caesar, his nephew and heir, Octavian, uses the threat of military force to compel the Roman Senate to elect him Consul.

t: 马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗在马库斯·安东尼乌斯的命令下在福尔米亚被暗杀。
te: Marcus Tullius Cicero is assassinated in Formia on orders of Marcus Antonius.
dz: 马库斯·图利乌斯·西塞罗在马库斯·安东尼乌斯的命令下在福尔米亚被暗杀。
de: Marcus Tullius Cicero is assassinated in Formia on orders of Marcus Antonius.
